questions.question: Ravi borrowed some money at the rate of 5% per annum for the first three years, 8% per annum for the next two years. and 10% per annum for the period beyond 5 years. If he paid a total simple interest of ₹12,750 at the end of 7 years, then how much money did he borrow?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total simple interest = ₹12,750, Time = 7 years.

5% per annum for the first three years, 8% per annum for two years. and 10% per annum for the period beyond 5 years.

**Concept used:**

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]

**Calculation: **

P = Principal

As per the question,

12,750 = (P × 3 × 5) / 100 + (P × 2 × 8) / 100 + (P × 2 × 10) / 100

⇒ 12,750 = 51P / 100 

⇒ P = Rs 25000

**∴ The correct option is 1**

questions.question: 4 men and 8 women complete a job in 10 days, and 5 men and 24 women complete the same work in 4 days. In how many days will 1 man and 1 woman complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given:

4 men and 8 women take 10 days

5 men and 24 women take 4 days

Formula used:

Total work = Efficiency × Number of days 

Calculation:

According to the question,

(4M + 8W) × 10 = (5M + 24W) × 4

⇒ 40M + 80W = 20M + 96W

⇒ 20M = 16W

⇒ M/W = 4/5

Now the total work = 10 (4M + 8W)

⇒ Total work = 10 × (4 × 4 + 8 × 5)

⇒ Total work = 10 × (16 + 40)

⇒ Total work = 560 units

Time required by 1 man and 1 woman to complete the work 

T (4 + 5) = 560

⇒ T = 560/9

⇒ T = 62(2/9) days

**∴ In 62(2/9) days, 1 man and 1 woman will complete the same work.**

questions.question: On parallel tracks, two trains of equal length are moving at speeds of 46 and 36 kilometres per hour in the same direction. In 36 seconds, the quicker train overtakes the slower one. The length of each train is:
questions.solution:

Speed of the trains are

**Concept used:**

Relative speed for the same direction = Difference of their speed

**Calculation: **

The relative speed of two trains is ,

So total relative distance covered in 36 seconds

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:** 

Time taken to cover 1st 12 × 2/3 = 8 km distance 

⇒ 8 × 60/10 = 48 minutes

Remaining time 78 - 48 = 30

Remaining distance 12 - 8 = 4 km

He has to travel 4 km in 30 minutes 

So the speed will be 4 × 2 = 8 km/h

**∴ The correct option is 2**
